source_audits.source_name: NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building
source_audits.publisher: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD), via NYC Open Data
source_audits.source_type: official NYC Open Data Socrata dataset
source_audits.description: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) reports on projects, buildings, and units that began after January 1, 2014, and are counted towards either the Housing New York plan (1/1/2014 – 12/31/2021) or the Housing Our Neighbors: A Blueprint for Housing & Homelessness plan (1/1/2022 – present).
source_audits.attribution: Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD)
source_audits.license: No dataset-specific license field exposed in Socrata metadata checked during this run; NYC Open Data Terms of Use / NYC.gov Terms of Use apply.
source_audits.reliability: strong for HPD affordable-housing production administrative milestones; usable with caveats for physical completion and occupancy claims
source_audits.published_coverage_note: Round292 fetched HPD building-level rows with coordinates and source date fields for duplicate screening; accepted candidates use completion dates only and exclude project_start_date.
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City HPD affordable housing production rows with address, BBL/BIN where available, and latitude/longitude geocoded points.
source_audits.granularity: One HPD project/building row. Multi-building projects can produce multiple building rows and project-level dates can repeat across buildings.
required_caveats: HPD production rows are administrative affordable-housing program/building delivery evidence, not a complete independent survey of all building completions.
Building completion, project completion, and project start fields are HPD source dates and are kept distinct from retrieval date.
Coordinates are HPD/Open Data geocoded points, not surveyed footprints, parcels, project boundaries, or proof of occupancy.
Unit counts, construction type, and extended-affordability status are source row values and may be updated or corrected by HPD.
Round292 excludes project_start_date rows from accepted candidates.

Preservation rows are retained only as HPD administrative completion-date records with coordinates and positive units; they are not treated as independent evidence of full construction scope or occupancy.
No causality, forecast, neighborhood impact, first occupancy, tenant move-in, or proof-of-outcomes claim is made from this dataset.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Append only with row-level Socrata URL, project/building source record id, source date field, coordinates, unit counts, attribution, NYC terms caveat, and limitations.
